track.title: The Same Light Returns
track.purpose: Make two ordered bass transformations return above one E-flat harmonic field.
track.hypothesis: A sparse fast pulse and retained chord identity can make operation order audible without losing space.
track.invariant: The chord pitch classes E-flat, G-flat, B-flat and F remain fixed. Both bass variants retain six onsets and ten rests.
